summary: Exact versions of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk below 1.32.0 are in the affected range for the October 2026 SDK advisories, including cross-origin redirect handling and bearer-token audience checks. A range without a lockfile is not an exact match.
remediation: Upgrade @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to 1.32.0 or newer and pin that version in the lockfile.
